problem: Second half reordered without need: the verse has जेहि बिधि उतरै कपि कटकु first and तात सो कहहु उपाइ after; Hindi grammar allows the verse's order (the English may keep its order, where grammar needs it).
fix: अत्यन्त विनीत वचन सुनते ही कृपालु प्रभुने मुस्कराकर कहा — जिस विधिसे वानरोंकी सेना पार उतरे, हे तात! वह उपाय कहो।

problem: 'सुनते ही … उसी क्षण' says 'at once' twice; सुनि is simply 'having heard', and only तुरतहिं means 'at once'.
fix: नाथ! इस बाणसे मेरे उत्तरी तटपर बसनेवाले उन दुष्ट मनुष्योंको मार डालिये, जो पापोंके ढेर हैं। समुद्रके मनकी यह व्यथा सुनकर कृपालु रणधीर श्रीरामजीने उसे उसी क्षण दूर कर दिया।

problem: The Hindi heading opens with the same four words as Gita Press's heading here (समुद्रपर श्रीरामजीका क्रोध); the brief asks for headings that are not their wording. The English heading is fine.
fix: श्रीरामजीका समुद्रपर कोप, समुद्रका शरणमें आना और सेतुका उपाय

problem: बाग is glossed 'बगीचा | garden'. Here बाग = वाक् (speech): बाग बिलास = वाग्विलास, show of words, big talk. The writer did not list this one.
fix: बाग: बगीचा / वाणी, वचन (वाक्; बाग बिलास = वाग्विलास) | garden / speech, words (vāk; bāga bilāsa = big talk)

problem: बिलासा is glossed 'आमोद | enjoyment'. In बाग बिलासा it means a display or play (of words), not enjoyment.
fix: बिलासा: विलास, आमोद / प्रदर्शन, क्रीड़ा (बाग बिलास = बातोंका दिखावा) | enjoyment / display, play (of words)

problem: करिही is glossed 'करेगी' (feminine singular), but its subject is प्रभु: 'will do / will show (grace)', honorific करेंगे.
fix: करिही: करेंगे, करेगा | will do (भविष्यत् काल, root करना)

problem: जेहिं is glossed 'जिसने | by whom', but in जेहिं यह सुजसु लोक तिहुँ गाइअ it means 'by which, so that'.
fix: जेहिं: जिसने / जिससे, जिस कारण (ताकि) | by whom / by which, so that (संबंधवाचक, root जो)

problem: सहाई is glossed only 'सहायक | helper'; in करिहउँ … सहाई it is the noun 'help' (करना सहाई = to help).
fix: सहाई: सहायक / सहायता | helper / help (करिहउँ सहाई = सहायता करूँगा)

problem: मानत is glossed 'मानते हैं | regard, consider'. The English lacks the sense the line needs: binaya na mānata = 'does not heed / give in to the entreaty'.
fix: मानत: मानते हैं, मानता है | regard, consider / heed, give in to (वर्तमान कृदंत, root मानना)

problem: धरिही is glossed 'धारण करेंगे | will assume'. In उर अपराध न एकउ धरिही it means 'will keep / hold (in the heart)'; 'assume' does not fit.
fix: धरिही: धारण करेंगे, रखेंगे | will assume / will keep, hold (भविष्यत्, root धरना)

problem: हरी is glossed 'हर लिया | carried off'. Here (पीरा … हरी) it means 'removed, took away (the pain)'.
fix: हरी: हर लिया | carried off / removed, took away (भूतकाल, स्त्रीलिंग, root हरना)

problem: Agree that the envoy sense is missing, but the suggested entry replaces the senses parrot / Śukadeva, which the work uses elsewhere (style §11: an entry lists every sense, separated by ' / '). Add, do not replace.
fix: सुक: तोता / शुकदेव / शुक (रावणका दूत) | parrot / sage Shuka / Śuka (Rāvaṇa's envoy) (root शुक)

problem: Agree सम = शम here, but the suggestion drops 'equal, like', the usual sense elsewhere. Add, do not replace.
fix: सम: समान, बराबर / शम, शान्ति | equal, like / calm, tranquillity (= शम)

problem: Agree 'strung' is missing, but the suggestion drops 'offered', which is used elsewhere. Add, do not replace.
fix: चढ़ावा: चढ़ाया (धनुषपर डोरी) / अर्पित किया | strung (a bow) / offered (भूतकाल, root चढ़ाना)

problem: Agree मकर = crocodile here, but the Capricorn / Māgha sense is used in the work (माघ मकरगत रबि, Bālakāṇḍa); the suggestion drops it. Add, do not replace.
fix: मकर: मगर (जल-जन्तु) / मकर राशि (माघमें सूर्यका मकरमें जाना) | crocodile, sea monster / Makara, Capricorn (the sun in Capricorn, Māgha)

problem: Agree तजि माना = giving up pride, but the suggestion drops the verb sense 'accepted, regarded', used elsewhere. Add, do not replace.
fix: माना: माना / मान, अभिमान | accepted, regarded / pride (भूतकाल / संज्ञा, root मानना / मान)

problem: Agree बिनय न मान needs the verb sense, but the suggestion drops 'honour / pride'. Add, do not replace.
fix: मान: मान, आदर / अभिमान / मानता है | honour / pride / heeds, yields to

problem: Agree नव = bends here, but the suggestion drops 'new / nine'. Add, do not replace.
fix: नव: नया / नौ / नवता है, झुकता है | new / nine / bends, bows

problem: Agree the line needs first person singular, but Awadhi जाब serves 'I' and 'we' alike; keep both rather than replace.
fix: जाब: जाऊँगा, जाएँगे | (I / we) shall go (भविष्यत्, उत्तम पुरुष, root जाना)

problem: Agree बल अनुमान = as far as strength allows, but the suggestion drops 'inference, guess' (अनुमान) used elsewhere. Add, do not replace.
fix: अनुमान: अनुमान, अंदाज़ा / अनुसार (बल अनुमान = बलके अनुसार) | inference, guess / in proportion to, as far as (bala anumāna = as far as one's strength allows)

problem: Agree उत्तर तट = northern shore, but the suggestion drops 'reply', the usual sense. Add, do not replace.
fix: उत्तर: जवाब / उत्तर दिशा | reply / north, northern

problem: Here the ocean acts as a person (he will not heed the entreaty), so style §6 asks for 'the Ocean', as the batch writes from sundar.58.cau4 on.
fix: The dull Ocean would not heed the entreaty, and three days went by. Then Śrī Rāma said in anger: Without fear there is no love.
